description: This file defines a deprecated class PdfParser that provides static methods to parse and extract text content from PDF files. It includes functions for reading PDF files, extracting textual elements, handling PDF stream data, and applying decoding filters.

classes.name: PdfParser
classes.description: A deprecated class for parsing PDF files and extracting text content, offering static methods for file and content parsing, as well as internal helper methods for processing PDF stream data.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Reads a PDF file and extracts text content from it.

methods.name: parseContent
methods.description: Extracts text content directly from a PDF string.

methods.name: extractText
methods.description: Converts PDF data into plain text by parsing PDF object streams and decoding filters.

methods.name: extractTextElements
methods.description: Processes a chunk of PDF stream content to extract readable text, handling PDF commands and encodings.

methods.name: parseTextCommand
methods.description: Extracts text from a PDF text operation string, handling spacing and escaping.

methods.name: getDataArray
methods.description: Splits PDF data into sections based on start and end delimiters.
